description: VALIS swept over its own caps (N x shipped; 1k is VALIS as shipped), with the DAPI opened by VALIS's own BioFormatsSlideReader, which hands VALIS every channel of the Xenium multi-file OME (VALIS registers on DAPI but builds its tissue mask from all channels). The H&E is read directly when VALIS reads it correctly, else from a cached lossless re-encode. The runner passes --dapi-reader from the method name.
